prompt_en: Make a surreal photograph showing a visible contradiction of ordinary physical relationships, realized as one coherent impossible event in a sunlit courtyard. The main subject is a woman guided by the supplied portrait. Use the supplied image for her visible face and hair appearance: the short dark jaw-length bob and wispy separated fringe, softly rounded facial outline, large dark eyes, small straight nose and softly full lips. Her real face remains natural in this new scene. She stands to the left of a plain cream plaster wall, both arms hanging straight down and both hands fully visible beside her outer thighs. She has just noticed her own cast shadow performing a different gesture. A continuous dark shadow begins at her two canvas shoes, crosses the stone ground and runs up the wall beside her. Its head outline repeats her short bob and its torso repeats her clothing silhouette, making ownership legible. While the real woman's two hands remain low, the shadow's right elbow is raised, its forearm upright and its open hand waving high above the shadow's head. The shadow's other arm hangs down. The actual woman is the single tangible figure in the courtyard; the other form is a flat matte cast shadow that follows the plaster texture and bends across the ground-to-wall seam. Keep the complete uninterrupted connection from both shoes across the ground to the wall silhouette visible together with the unmistakably different arm positions. The woman's face turns toward the raised shadow hand with a small incredulous smile; a three-quarter view keeps her face and both eyes readable. A loose terracotta linen shirt, light stone trousers and cream canvas shoes make her an ordinary visitor caught in an inexplicable encounter. Low afternoon sunlight from frame left gives her cheek, fringe and linen a warm tactile brightness, and produces a crisp dark shadow against the unadorned wall. A narrow architectural eave at the far left casts an ordinary straight-edged shadow across the wall and paving in the same sun direction that models her face; this small normal comparison stays separate from her waving silhouette. Frame her full body at the left and the complete shadow at the right, with clear margin above the raised shadow fingertips and below her shoes. Use a natural standing camera position and a moderate wide lens, keeping the face, actual hands, shoe connection, wall seam and raised shadow hand clear in the same photograph. The quiet courtyard, worn paving joints, tiny plaster irregularities and restrained colors lend the impossible behavior the convincing presence of an everyday observed moment.
